_comment: Single source for the claim and spam lexicons. Read by scripts/audit/claims-grep.mjs, scripts/audit/spam-grep.mjs and .claude/hooks/post-edit-lint.ps1 (the hook cannot carry Hebrew literals: PS 5.1 mis-decodes non-ASCII in -File scripts). Each claim maps a regex to the docs/business-facts.md row that would have to be confirmed before the phrase may ship as fact. status: unconfirmed = a live hit fails the audit; never = never permitted (content-standards.md section 6); gated = allowed only when the named guard is set.

claims.note: No licence or grade has been supplied; the 2026-08-17 owner intake says it is not coming.

claims.pattern: תעודת הסמכה|הסמכה|מוסמך על ידי|הכשרה של היצרן
שנות ניסיון|ניסיון רב|ניסיון של \d+|מעל \d+ שנ|למעלה מ-?\d+ שנ|עשרות שנים
claims.row: Owner's years in the trade / Year founded
claims.note: foundedYear is null in the manifest. Replace duration claims with mechanism depth.
No term, scope or exclusions exist. Say 'אחריות על העבודה' instead.

claims.pattern: פריסה ארצית|בכל הארץ|בכל רחבי הארץ|מכל רחבי הארץ
claims.note: The manifest areaServed carries the phrase; the 14 published locations run from חיפה to אשקלון, the שרון region among them. The owner confirmed on 2026-11-09 that קריות, צפון, דרום and באר שבע are not served.

claims.row: Is 24/7 emergency service real, and where?

claims.pattern: תוך \d+ דקות|תוך שעה|באותו היום|הגעה מיידית|תוך \d+ שעות

claims.note: Allowed only when lib/content.ts REVIEW_SOURCE_URL is set and reviews are verbatim.
Added in Sprint 4F after the aboutValues and aboutSections lines. Replace with the mechanism (the check order, what is checked).
No person may be named until business-facts §B carries the name and permission.

claims.pattern: מסביר(?:ים)? (?:לכם )?(?:מה התקלה ו)?מה (?:ה)?עלות|מה (?:ה)?עלות לפני|הסבר על העלות לפני|הצעת מחיר (?:שקופה|חינם|לפני (?:ש|העבודה|התיקון))|הצעה שקופה|מחיר שקוף|מחיר לפני העבודה|אבחון לפני מחיר|(?:בלי|ללא) הפתעות|ייעוץ והצעת מחיר|המחיר נקבע באבחון
claims.note: Added in P1 after the 2026-11-09 audit (H2, M4); widened in the P1 fix pass (the contact meta and the מודיעין answer). When a quote is given and whether it binds has no business-facts row of its own (owner-actions 3.4). Explains what the fault is and what needs fixing is the model (processSteps step 2); say what the price depends on, never when it is given or that it is transparent.

claims.row: Is the visit fee waived on repair
claims.note: Added in P1 after the 2026-11-09 audit (H2, M4). Whether a visit, a diagnosis or a quote is free or binding is unconfirmed (owner-actions 3.4); name what the caller gets, not the terms.

Added in P1 after the 2026-11-09 audit (M1, M4). A durability promise reads as a warranty-scope promise. Describe the method (match the part to the gate, check what wore it out), never how long the repair lasts. Advice that a maintained part lasts longer is not a promise and does not match. Widened in fix pass 2 (claims-verifier): a service that guarantees smooth operation for years, and the heading עמידות לאורך זמן.

Added in the P1 fix pass (audit 2026-11-09 M2). /מחירון/ lists no per-service price since N14 (af8ba4c), only the visit band; a line that sends readers to a full price list or to published maintenance prices is false. Point at what the page explains: בעמוד המחירון באתר מוסבר מה קובע את העלות.
